hero.title: A UK truck sales partner built around clear adverts.
hero.copy: We help hauliers, builders, owner-drivers and fleet managers compare used commercial vehicles with the key details visible before they travel.

approach.heading: We keep the buying process practical and transparent.
approach.p1: MidLand Trucks is focused on used commercial vehicle sales across the UK, with delivery arranged worldwide. Our role is simple: prepare useful information, match buyers with the right truck and make reservation, finance, part exchange and delivery easier to arrange.
approach.p2: Every buyer gets the details they need to compare stock properly: mileage, year, gearbox, cab type, VAT status, MOT notes, Euro rating, condition notes and location. For serious enquiries we can provide extra photos, walkaround videos and inspection support.

sections.heading: Customer data
sections.copy: Enquiry details are stored in the website database and are available only to authorised administration users responding to vehicle, finance, delivery and part exchange requests. Contact the sales team to request access, correction or deletion.

sections.heading: Vehicle information
sections.copy: Listings are prepared in good faith from available stock information. Buyers should confirm final specification, VAT status, MOT, condition, mileage, Clean Air Zone suitability and availability before purchase.

sections.heading: Reservation and payment terms
sections.copy: This website does not take online payments. Deposits, reservations, finance introductions, delivery, part exchange values, the full price, taxes and cancellation terms are confirmed directly with the sales team before a sale is completed.

sections.heading: Finance and cookies
sections.copy: The finance calculator is indicative and does not submit an application to a lender. The cookie preference is stored in your browser; this website does not currently activate analytics or marketing cookies.

faqs.question: Can I reserve a truck remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can share extra photos, arrange a video walkaround and hold stock after final availability checks and agreed deposit terms.

faqs.question: Do you arrange finance?
faqs.answer: We can introduce commercial finance options for eligible UK businesses and owner-drivers.

faqs.question: Can I part exchange my vehicle?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send registration, mileage, condition notes and photos so the team can prepare a trade estimate.

faqs.question: Do prices include VAT?
faqs.answer: Each listing should show whether the price is plus VAT, VAT included or no VAT. Final VAT status is confirmed on the invoice before payment.

faqs.question: Can trucks be delivered?
faqs.answer: Yes. We arrange UK and European road delivery plus worldwide sea freight export, or you're welcome to collect from the sales location.

faqs.question: Do you show MOT and Clean Air Zone information?
faqs.answer: Listings include MOT status and Euro/CAZ notes where available. Buyers should still verify registration-specific details before use.
